Additional task-specific guidelines retrieved from similar past tasks:
- When counting formatted items within a note, retrieve the note content using the official service API (e.g., 'notes.py read <note_id>') to avoid relying on local file state.
- To count the number of completed checklist items, iterate only over lines in the note content that strictly match the checklist format (e.g., lines starting with '- [x] ').
- When extracting specific structured data (such as completed checklist items) from a note using an API, always read the note content in its entirety via the appropriate API call and process the content programmatically rather than relying on contextual clues or partial outputs.
